summary: The filing reports Zimmer Biomet Holdings' entry into two new revolving credit facilities: a $1.5 billion five-year unsecured facility maturing June 26, 2031 (with two one-year extension options and up to $750 million incremental capacity) and a 364-day revolving facility. Borrowings bear floating rates based on adjusted Term SOFR or an alternate base rate plus a margin tied to the company's credit rating, with a facility fee on the aggregate amount. Covenants include a consolidated leverage ratio not exceeding 4.5x (or 5.0x after a qualified acquisition). This is a routine refinancing for general corporate purposes, not a special situation.
